READ THE LAYERS CORRECTLY

Every geography has a definition and a date.

National localities

ABS SAL 2026 are statistical approximations of gazetted suburbs and localities. They differ from the detailed NSW official locality polygons. Nineteen special nonspatial records remain in the national workbook and are omitted from the map.

Relationships, not a forced hierarchy

A locality can intersect more than one council, electorate or postal area. All positive-area associations are preserved. The primary association is the largest area, not a population weight.

Mixed geographic editions

Core boundaries use ASGS Edition 4 (2026). Remoteness, urban and tourism layers use Edition 3 (2021). Federal layers use the latest determined state-specific AEC boundaries; some first general election dates remain pending. These are not a current MP lookup.

Locus supplemental segments

Mosaic, Helix, Census and SEIFA values come from your supplied workbook. Census rows mix 2016 and 2021; commercial segment and SEIFA years are unknown unless stated. No nearest-postcode substitution is used. Unexplained Mosaic numeric columns are excluded.

Postcodes and privacy

ABS postal areas approximate delivery postcodes. A postcode association cannot establish an individual's attributes or an exact property location. Segment labels describe supplied area context.

Map precision

The map uses polygons simplified at 25 metres for display. Spreadsheet overlaps use full source geometry or common 2026 mesh-block allocations. Business point matches in this browser are approximate near boundaries. Imports stay in this tab.
